scene: Your ukulele chords summon three departure docks, glowing along the sky boardwalk.
picture: A flat side view along a wide wooden boardwalk. Far left, the player in a floral shirt holds his ukulele. Left, a wooden solar-sail junk floats at a low mooring. Centre, a serpentine maglev dragon train hums beside a post. Right, a shiny pink bullet train rests on magnetic rails. Far right, glowing destination signs.
shown: a moored solar-sail junk with shimmering golden canvas panels, docked on the left
a maglev dragon train head idling beside a ticket gate, at the centre
a sleek pink bullet train with open slide doors, waiting on the right
